name: security-audit
description: Security-audit skill that turns the agent into a security auditor — guidance by default, and on an explicit audit request a six-phase workflow (reconnaissance → coverage-led hunting → candidate validation → structured output → independent record verification → target-neutral report) that finds vulnerabilities crossing a real trust boundary, not checklist deviations. Vendored from cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT). Complements code-audit-rigor: this one actively hunts exploits; code-audit-rigor governs PR/branch review with quantitative decision frameworks.
